title: P2RLN SCORM Package Profile
description: Preserves a SCORM 1.2 or SCORM 2004 package as an executable representation while projecting course/item structure into the P2RLN graph when available.
rules: An original SCORM ZIP SHOULD be preserved byte-for-byte when available.
The SCORM manifest and runtime remain authoritative for SCORM launch, sequencing and run-time behavior.
P2RLN MAY project organization/item/resource metadata into Core entities but MUST NOT claim that projection replaces SCORM sequencing semantics.
A representation using this profile SHOULD expose detected SCORM version, manifest path, resource identifier, launch href and scormType in its profile extension.
Server-side source files found inside a preserved SCORM package MUST NOT be executed merely because the package was imported.
